External service: candidate SMS sender, text and received time are sent to the selected LLM provider. Other financial records are never sent. API keys are encrypted with Android Keystore. No cloud backup or analytics.
OpenCode Go is designed for coding agents. SMS parsing may fall outside its intended use and may be throttled. Use a separate finance key.
Save applies this provider and its settings. Existing queued messages are never reassigned without confirmation in Review.

Only new incoming SMS are received; history is never read. On Android 13+, a sideloaded app may need App info → ⋮ → Allow restricted settings before SMS can be granted. If your phone blocks permission, manual entry remains fully available.
Start with a lowercase letter; use lowercase letters, digits or underscores.
Delete this category? Its transactions move to Other.
Use a unique lowercase key and both labels. Other cannot be hidden or deleted.
Track spending from bank SMS or add transactions yourself. Your ledger stays on this phone.\n\nStart manually, or set up optional AI-assisted SMS processing when you are ready.

New incoming SMS are filtered on this device. Messages recognized as one-time passwords are ignored, not stored. SMS history is never read.\n\nOnly a candidate message, its sender and received time go to your chosen AI provider. The result is checked against the original text; uncertain results go to Review.

Manual entry works without SMS permission or an API key. Add, edit or delete transactions and organize your categories.\n\nIn Review, correct drafts, retry processing or dismiss a message. Duplicate checks help prevent recording the same movement twice.
For optional SMS processing, add your own provider key in Settings, then grant incoming SMS permission there. This tutorial does not request permission or send messages.
Tap + on Dashboard or Transactions to add a record. Visit Settings whenever you want to configure a provider or enable incoming SMS.\n\nYou can replay this guide from Show tutorial in Settings.
